title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-06-30
summary: Weekly release engineering sync focused on next release train (v2026.06.3), current hotfix rollout, and changelog items. Decisions made around canary window extension and hotfix backport prioritization.
body:
Attendees: Sofia Martinez (owner), Markus Li, Priya Desai, Ethan Brooks, Nora Chen, Lina Gomez (SRE)

Agenda:
- Quick status: current release train v2026.06.3
- Hotfix HLX-211: regression in multi-tenant KV cache eviction
- Changelog highlights and release notes draft
- Canary rollout metrics and extension proposal
- Action items and owners

Notes:
1) Release train v2026.06.3
- Target ship: 2026-07-02 (EOD). Current RC built on 2026-06-29. Regression suite: 94/100 passing; remaining failures are non-blocking perf flakiness on nvbench.
- PRs merged since last sync: performance/kv-cache-eviction (PR #3382), http2-connection-retries, observability/tracing-enhancements.
- Decided to keep feature flag for kv-cache tuning enabled for Dedicated customers only for first 48 hours post-release.

2) Hotfix HLX-211 (KV cache eviction bug)
- Issue: under heavy multi-tenant churn, certain clients saw cache entries evicted prematurely causing tail-latency spikes.
- Root cause: race between eviction callback and async KV commitment on v2 runtime path (introduced in perf refactor).
- Current status: Fix merged to main and backported to release branch (backport PR created). Backport verified on staging with synthetic tenant churn tests.
- Rollout: Hotfix began canary at 09:00 UTC 2026-06-30 to 5% traffic. Initial metrics: error rate stable, 99th percentile latency improved by ~18% for affected calls.
- Decision: extend canary to 12 hours and increase to 25% if metrics remain stable. If no regressions, schedule full rollout in three phases over 48 hours.

3) Changelog / Release notes
- Draft highlights for v2026.06.3 to include:
  * Improved KV cache eviction logic for multi-tenant workloads (reduced tail latency)
  * HTTP/2 connection retry improvements (fewer transient 502s)
  * New tracing hooks in Console for per-route token breakdowns
  * Several bugfixes: embedding dedup, dashboard CSV export, canary autoscale bug
- Priya will take first pass at release notes and publish draft to Confluence by 2026-07-01 11:00 PT. Markus to add upgrade/rollback instructions.

4) Canary rollout and metrics
- Lina (SRE) presented canary dashboard: key signals to watch are 99p latency, error rate, CPU/GPU utilization, and request queue length. For this train add KV-cache eviction counters and observed eviction latency distribution.
- Agreed threshold for abort: >2x error rate relative to baseline OR sustained 99p latency increase >25% for 15+ minutes.
- For HLX-211 hotfix, temporary alert thresholds will be relaxed for autoscaler perturbations but SRE will monitor closely.

5) Risks & open questions
- nvbench flakiness: still causing CI noise; release team to mark flaky tests and file follow-up with release-engineering/qa for investigation (#JIRA-TEST-709).
- Customer upgrades: two Dedicated customers (ACME and FinFlow) requested a paused rollout until tenant-specific testing completes. Action: sales/sre to coordinate; offer private canary clusters.
- Rollback plan: standard rollback via traffic split and promotion of previous artifact; Markus to validate rollback runbook and test in staging by 2026-07-01.

Action items:
- Priya Desai: Draft release notes and post draft to Confluence by 2026-07-01 11:00 PT. (status: in progress)
- Markus Li: Finalize upgrade/rollback instructions + verify rollback in staging by 2026-07-01 EOD. (status: open)
- Lina Gomez (SRE): Monitor HLX-211 canary metrics, provide 4-hour cadence updates while canary extended. (status: in progress)
- Ethan Brooks: Verify backport PR test coverage and add regression test for multi-tenant eviction behavior (due 2026-07-05). (status: open)
- Nora Chen: Coordinate with Account Execs for ACME/FinFlow private canary windows; propose schedule by 2026-07-02. (status: open)
- Release engineer on-call: tag all release artifacts with build id and update release metadata in Confluence (owner: Sofia). (status: assigned)

Decisions made:
- Extend HLX-211 canary window to 12 hours and increase traffic to 25% if stable.
- Keep KV-cache tuning feature flag enabled for Dedicated only for 48 hours post-release.
- Publish release notes on 2026-07-02 morning with clear upgrade/rollback instructions.

Meeting adjourned: 10:05 UTC. Next sync: Ad-hoc if canary shows anomalies, otherwise weekly release sync on 2026-07-07.

Notes to self / loose TODOs:
- Consider adding automatic eviction diagnostic logs gated by a sampling flag to reduce noise.
- Follow up with QA to reduce nvbench flakiness; prioritize stable perf tests in next sprint.
- Update internal playbook with clearer thresholds for eviction-related incidents.
